result.summary: The page layout is mostly intact, but the promotional banner has near-illegible white-on-light-green text, and several horizontally scrolling sections are clipped hard at the screen edge without any trailing padding. Favourite (heart) buttons also use inconsistent styling between cards.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner uses white text on a pale mint green background. The headline, subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') fail contrast requirements and are barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Switch the banner copy to a dark green/near-black text colour, or darken the banner background so text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel's third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut flush against the right screen edge — image, title and delivery price are all sliced with no gutter, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing/leading padding (e.g. 16px) to the carousel content inset so partially visible cards are clearly peeking rather than clipped at 0px, and allow the card title to ellipsize cleanly.

issues.description: The category chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy, …') is also clipped at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same horizontal content inset and consider a fade/gradient mask at the edge to signal scrollability.

issues.description: Favourite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with dark outline, while the pizza card below uses a dark translucent circle with white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button to a single treatment (e.g. white circle with dark icon) across all restaurant cards regardless of image brightness, or apply a consistent scrim.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly truncated by the bottom navigation bar with no card metadata visible, and the divider above the tab bar cuts through the image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully clear of the navigation, and use a solid/blurred tab bar background instead of a thin line over content.
